Evaluate the following statement using only the passage, choosing an assessment with a sound justification:

Alder was posted on Sunday.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Not deducible: the passage does not settle it.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Not deducible, because the passage supplies no receipt time for Alder.

options.label: D
options.textMd: True: it follows from the passage.

explanationMd: Only receipt time is supplied; posting time cannot be recovered from it.
